theorems.name: Submission.cmr_vr_coordinate_functional
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (d : ℕ) (L : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → |L g| ≤ M) → ∀ i : Fin d, ∃ Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ) (g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))), (∀ x, g x = f x • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) → L g = Λ f) ∧ ∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, tsupport f ⊆ K → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) → |Λ f| ≤ M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
